title: Nakhon Si Thammarat — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Nakhon Si Thammarat: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Nakhon Si Thammarat has a population of 120,000. An ancient southern city with a rich history, stunning temples, and one of the lowest costs of living in Thailand, ideal for those seeking authentic Thai culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 49 sunny days a year.
